journey.name: wear send hold cancel
journey.description:
A tap on the pay button, or a hold released before the ring is full, pays nothing: the review stays and the balance does not change. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet on the local ./spark stack with at least 2 000 sats, see journeys/wear/README.md › Local ./spark stack, with the app open on the Balance page and the loading ring stopped. README › Holding to pay has the gestures.

actions.action: Run `../bitkit-docker/spark invoice 1000` and note the BOLT11 invoice it prints as <invoice>
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Wait up to 10 s until "WatchSendHold" is listed
Verify the review stays: "WatchSendHold" is still listed
Hold "WatchSendHold" for 0.5 s and release, as in README › Holding to pay
Verify the review stays: "WatchSendHold" is still listed
Swipe to dismiss from the left edge: `adb shell input swipe 20 227 400 227 300`
